tools.description: Read the selected KrabiClaw site’s identity, public address and settings. organization_id is the internal ID returned by get_workspace_context or list_organizations, not a URL, domain or business name.

organization_id.description: Internal KrabiClaw organization ID from get_workspace_context or list_organizations, e.g. org-pottery-house. Do not pass a public URL, hostname, subdomain, custom domain, slug, or business name here.

tools.name: get_organization_analytics
tools.title: Get organization analytics
tools.description: Read website traffic, attribution, conversions, bookings, collected revenue and refunds. Amounts are minor units per currency; booking quotes are not collected revenue.

end_date.description: Inclusive local end date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today.

organization_id.description: Internal KrabiClaw organization ID from get_workspace_context or list_organizations, e.g. org-pottery-house. Do not pass a public URL, hostname, subdomain, custom domain, slug, or business name here.

start_date.description: Inclusive local start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to 29 days before end_date.

tools.name: get_organization_media_assets
tools.title: Get organization media assets
tools.description: List the images, videos and Markdown files in the selected site’s media library, with the asset IDs set_media and attach_media take. A file still in the conversation is saved with save_media_attachment.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the previous page.

organization_id.description: Internal KrabiClaw organization ID from get_workspace_context or list_organizations, e.g. org-pottery-house. Do not pass a public URL, hostname, subdomain, custom domain, slug, or business name here.

tools.name: get_organization_settings
tools.title: Get organization settings
tools.description: Read editable settings for the selected KrabiClaw site. Use its internal organization_id from get_workspace_context or list_organizations, not its public URL, domain or name.

organization_id.description: Internal KrabiClaw organization ID from get_workspace_context or list_organizations, e.g. org-pottery-house. Do not pass a public URL, hostname, subdomain, custom domain, slug, or business name here.

announcement.description: The universal announcement banner or modal shown to visitors on the public website, available to every theme. An image, when set, is a separate organization media placement (slot "announcement"), not a field here.

cta_label.description: Button label. Requires cta_url and vice versa.

cta_url.description: Button destination, http or https. Requires cta_label and vice versa.

dismissible.description: Whether a visitor who closes it will not be shown it again on that device.

enabled.description: Whether the announcement is currently shown. false keeps the saved content without showing it.

format.description: Display style: modal popup dialog or top banner bar (default modal).

headline.description: Required in every write, even an empty string when disabling without discarding it.

palette.description: The colors the site renders, light and dark: its own, or its template's. Null on the platform template.

surface.description: Cards, the header and footer, dialogs and fields.

tools.name: get_payment
tools.title: Get payment
tools.description: Read one customer payment belonging to the selected business, including its original purchase details, current refund records, disputes and authenticated dashboard URL. Requires payment_id from list_payments. Does not issue a refund, prepare an approval or change payment state; use the authenticated dashboard for financial actions.

organization_id.description: Internal KrabiClaw organization ID from get_workspace_context or list_organizations, e.g. org-pottery-house. Do not pass a public URL, hostname, subdomain, custom domain, slug, or business name here.

tools.name: get_payment_payouts
tools.title: Get payment payouts
tools.description: Read the selected business’s connected Stripe balance and payout history, with source and retrieval time. Continue with next_cursor as after for another page. Use get_payment_summary for customer payment totals. This is a read of the business’s own connected account; it does not create a payout or transfer funds.

after.description: next_cursor from the previous payout page.

organization_id.description: Internal KrabiClaw organization ID from get_workspace_context or list_organizations, e.g. org-pottery-house. Do not pass a public URL, hostname, subdomain, custom domain, slug, or business name here.

tools.name: get_payment_summary
tools.title: Get payment summary

organization_id.description: Internal KrabiClaw organization ID from get_workspace_context or list_organizations, e.g. org-pottery-house. Do not pass a public URL, hostname, subdomain, custom domain, slug, or business name here.

tools.name: get_payments_dashboard_link
tools.title: Get payments dashboard link
tools.description: Get the selected business’s authenticated Payments setup and dashboard URL when the owner wants to manage its Stripe integration. Returns a link for the person to open; it does not open a page, create an account, start onboarding, prepare a refund or change the integration. Identity and bank details are entered only in the dashboard’s Stripe-hosted flow.

organization_id.description: Internal KrabiClaw organization ID from get_workspace_context or list_organizations, e.g. org-pottery-house. Do not pass a public URL, hostname, subdomain, custom domain, slug, or business name here.

tools.name: get_payments_usage
tools.title: Get payments usage
tools.description: Read the selected business’s KrabiClaw Payments fees: the rates its plan subscription’s metered prices charge for payment volume, Stripe fees and managed ad spend, and usage not yet reported to Stripe. rendered.text: Update the catalog from: <items_description> Use get_workspace_context, list_organizations and list_locations to resolve the business and explicit location. Read every relevant list_location_products and list_collections page before matching existing IDs. For a restaurant menu, use update_menu with a stable idempotency_key, the stated sections and prices. Match existing product, variant, price and collection IDs. Omitted items and order remain; use set_collection_products or reorder_collections only when the user requests a complete new order. For other products, use create_product for new entries or update_product for partial edits. Use reconcile_products only when the user requests complete replacement of the supplied entries. Ask for missing prices or booking facts. Use get_product and list_location_products to read back the result, then open the returned public URL before reporting completion.

prompts.name: create_and_publish_post
prompts.description: Create a short post, review its draft, and publish it to the destinations the user names.

arguments.name: body
arguments.description: The caption, as the user wants it read. Event dates, offers and codes are part of it.

arguments.name: destinations
arguments.description: Where to publish, in the user's words: website, Facebook, Instagram, Discord, or several. Nothing is assumed.

rendered.text: Call create_post with a new idempotency_key and this body: <body> If the user supplied or approved media, pass it as create_post media in the order they want it shown: the cover first, then the gallery. Publish only to: <destinations>. For Facebook, Instagram or Discord, call get_social_connections and use the exact target_id and connection_revision it returns; if the destination is not connected or has a problem, say so instead of publishing elsewhere. Show the user the draft's preview_url, then call publish_post with the post's updated_at as expected_updated_at and one target per named destination. Report each outcome exactly as returned. processing means call publish_post again later to finish the same post; unknown means use reconcile_post_publication, never publish again.

prompts.name: set_up_bookable_product
prompts.description: Create a new bookable Product from a description.

arguments.name: description
arguments.description: What it is, including price/duration/capacity if known.

rendered.text: Create a bookable offering from: <description> Use get_workspace_context, list_locations and list_products to resolve the business, existing offerings and explicit location or online scope. Ask for missing price, duration, capacity, actual start times, confirmation and payment choices. Use create_product with booking setup and one idempotency key. Preserve the supplied facts and attach supplied media to the returned product ID. Use get_product to read booking_readiness and list_product_booking_sessions with a concrete date range to verify actual availability. Use save_media_attachment for supplied files or attach_media for existing assets. Open the returned public URL before reporting completion.

prompts.name: triage_inbox
prompts.description: Summarize guest conversations, pending bookings and reviews awaiting a reply.

rendered.description: Summarize guest conversations, pending bookings, and unreplied reviews
rendered.text: Use get_workspace_context to resolve the requested business. Read all relevant list_guest_conversations pages and get_guest_conversation for full contact messages, table reservation and product booking details, proposals and delivery receipts. Summarize unanswered messages and pending bookings. Use reply_to_guest with a stable idempotency_key only for the message or photo the user requests. Use get_product_booking before confirm_product_booking, reject_product_booking, cancel_product_booking or request_product_booking_change; use cancel_table_reservation or request_table_reservation_change for an explicitly requested table reservation action. Booking changes email a proposal and leave the existing allocation unchanged until guest acceptance. Financial actions requiring the dashboard remain incomplete; report the returned handoff instead of claiming completion. Use list_locations and list_location_reviews to read reviews separately; provider reviews and imported Google Q&A remain managed in Google. Report failed deliveries and actions awaiting guest acceptance accurately.

prompts.name: improve_my_homepage
prompts.description: Review the homepage and suggest the highest-impact changes to make it look better and more inviting.

rendered.text: Use get_workspace_context, list_site_pages and get_site_page to read the selected business's homepage, and get_organization_media_assets for its media. Open its public preview and recommend the most useful improvements in plain language. Apply requested copy changes with update_site_page; use set_media for one image or attach_media, remove_media and reorder_media for a gallery. Read back the page and public result.

prompts.name: add_photos_to_organization
prompts.description: Add the user's own photos to the right places on the site (homepage, location, Products, or posts).

rendered.text: Inspect the supplied photos and use get_workspace_context plus the relevant get_site_page, get_location, get_product or get_post read to resolve the intended owner and placement. Ask only about an ambiguous destination. Use save_media_attachment with a stable idempotency_key and the intended placement for each attachment; retries reuse that key. For an existing asset use set_media or attach_media. Read back the owner and open the public result before reporting placement.

prompts.name: finish_my_organization_setup
prompts.description: Identify missing business facts and finish the requested site setup.

rendered.text: Use get_workspace_context and list_organizations to resolve the business. For an unfinished website use get_website_draft, save_website_draft and publish_website with the returned draft ID and revision. For an existing website use get_organization, list_locations, list_site_pages, get_site_page and list_products to identify the missing facts. Ask for those facts, use update_organization_settings, update_site_page, update_menu or create_product for the requested setup, and read back its public result.

prompts.name: make_organization_more_bookable
prompts.description: Review calls-to-action, contact info, and reservation/booking setup, and suggest changes to get more bookings.

rendered.text: Use get_workspace_context, list_products, get_product and list_product_booking_sessions to read the public offering, booking readiness and actual availability. Use list_locations, get_location and get_reservation_policy for location hours and table reservation setup. Identify what prevents guests from booking and ask for missing business facts. Use update_product with booking setup, set_product_booking_config, replace_product_weekly_schedule or update_reservation_policy for the changes the user requests. Read back readiness, available times and the public result.

prompts.name: make_my_organization_look_better
prompts.description: Review the website and recommend concrete visual and content improvements.

rendered.text: Use get_workspace_context, list_site_pages, get_site_page, get_organization_media_assets and list_products to read the actual public pages, media and catalog. Recommend specific improvements in plain language. Apply the requested copy with update_site_page or update_product, and media with set_media or attach_media. Read back the changed record and verify the public result.

prompts.name: grow_my_bookings
prompts.description: Look at traffic, listing completeness, and booking/reservation demand together, and suggest the highest-impact next move to get more bookings this week.

rendered.text: Use get_workspace_context and get_organization_analytics to read recent traffic. Use list_products, get_product and list_product_booking_sessions for bookable offerings and availability, and list_guest_conversations plus get_guest_conversation for current guest demand. Recommend the most useful action supported by those records. Use reply_to_guest, update_product or create_post and publish_post for the action the user requests, then read back its actual outcome and report any incomplete delivery or dashboard handoff.
